messages.content: Extract each remuneration-for-service record expressly stated in current facts. Preserve payer, payee, amount, worker, employer, literal payment medium when stated, service kind, service location, service endpoints, and a payment date only when expressly supplied. A service period is not a payment date. is_query_service and is_query_payment may align only an independently facts-witnessed record to the actual native event roles. Do not route an ordinary wage record through a termination/disability episode, infer wages, allocate across years, total amounts, or copy a target claim. Every record needs facts evidence; complete [] is finite absence and unread uses null.
